name: Mindlink Mech — copy "except it's 4/3, it's a Vehicle artifact in addition to its other types"
notes: Reported 2026-11-22. The copy exception's "in addition to" reader captured from the first "it's" ("4/3, it's a Vehicle artifact"), so after the 4/3 was taken out the words "it's" and "a" became subtypes beside Vehicle. Now only the words after the last "it's" are the types: a Bear Vehicle artifact creature, 4/3, with flying.
